name: Vault Door
description: The sealed round door of a pre-Cataclysm bunker, set into a slope of concrete.
role: The entrance to relic vaults. A quest can open it; a map can only show it.

artBrief.silhouette: Round door in a square frame.
artBrief.detail: Radial bolts, a central wheel and hazard stripes on the frame.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Steel greys, faded yellow and black hazard stripes.
